name: RAS News
description: Rise & Shine editorial carousel per ras-brand-guidelines.md: Daybreak Paper canvas, Midnight Ink Satoshi type with Instrument Serif accent, RAS by KeilHQ footer logo. Slide 1 of N is the COVER: headline announces the news and its hero image MUST be a centered company/product logotype on flat Soft Linen, symmetrical, no people, no overlay text (rendered contained with viewfinder corners). Slides 2 to N are CONTENT: each hero image MUST be a black-and-white editorial photograph with the subject right-of-center and empty blurred copy-space left for the overlay ID badge — never another logotype card.
